newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest bourse approves Human upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Budapest bourse approves Human upgrade.

text.p: The Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) has approved Hungarian pharmaceuticals company Human Rt's request to transfer its shares to the "listed A" category from the "listed B" category, the BSE said on Monday.
"Human shares will be transferred to the 'listed A' category from January 7," the BCE said in a statement.
The "listed A" differs from the "listed B" category in its stricter obligations on providing information, including a quarterly report.
Human applied for requalification on December 23.
Human is majority-owned by Canada's Novopharm Ltd.
On the Budapest bourse Human shares closed on Monday at 2,770 forints, up 20.
